hint.connecting: Connecting to Tether for live updates…
hint.open: Connected: updates arrive in real time

login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Reset it from the terminal on the machine running Tether.

setup.title: Set up Tether
setup.intro: A few steps and you can reach your Claude Code sessions from this dashboard and from Telegram.

language.title: Choose your language
language.description: Used by the dashboard and as the default for the Telegram bot. You can change it later.

password.title: Create a password
password.description: It protects this dashboard, and the Telegram bot asks for it before giving anyone access.

phones.title: Allowed phone numbers
phones.description: Only Telegram accounts with one of these numbers can use the bot.
phones.howVerified: Telegram verifies your number: the bot will ask you to share your contact, which proves the account owns that number. Typing a number is never enough.
phones.label: Phone number
phones.hint: Include the country code. Digits only, with an optional leading +.
phones.invalid: Enter a valid number: 6 to 15 digits, optional +.
phones.required: Add at least one phone number.

telegram.title: Connect a Telegram bot
telegram.description: Optional. You can skip this and add the token later in Settings.
telegram.step3: Paste the token it gives you below.
telegram.optional: Optional: leave empty to set it up later.
telegram.invalid: That doesn't look like a bot token (123456789:ABC…).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Every Claude Code session on this machine, at a glance.

limits.title: Account limits
limits.unknown: No limit data yet. It arrives with Claude Code's status line.

context.title: Context by session
context.emptyHint: Create a session or adopt one that is already running in tmux.

usage.title: Usage over time · 24h
usage.emptyHint: Points appear as sessions report their status line.

activity.emptyHint: Prompts, tool calls and permission requests show up here.

new.title: New session
new.description: Starts Claude Code in a new tmux session.
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: Optional. Defaults to the folder name.
new.cwdHint: Type a path; suggestions come from this machine. Tab completes.
new.continueHint: Resume the most recent conversation in this folder (claude -c).

adopt.title: Adopt a tmux session
adopt.description: Take over a Claude Code session that is already running in tmux.
adopt.permissionModeHint: Tells Tether whether this Claude asks for permission or runs unattended.
adopt.noneHint: Every tmux session on this machine is already managed, or none are running.

ask.label: Ask
ask.description: Permission prompts are forwarded to you here and on Telegram.

bypass.label: Bypass
bypass.description: Claude runs every tool without asking (--dangerously-skip-permissions).
bypass.warning: Claude will edit files and run commands on this machine without asking. Use it only in folders you trust and with work you can undo.

commands.title: Commands
commands.keys: ↑↓ to move · Enter to run · Esc to close
commands.cost: Show the cost of this session

chat.emptyHint: Send a prompt below. Type / for commands.
chat.placeholderOffline: This session is offline. Restart it to send messages.
chat.keysHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

panel.name: Session name
panel.noHistory: Not enough history for a chart yet.

confirmClear.title: Clear the context?
confirmClear.description: Runs /clear. Claude starts a fresh conversation; the current one stays in its transcript history.

confirmRestart.title: Restart this session?
confirmRestart.description: Stops Claude Code in this tmux session and starts it again in the same folder. Anything in progress is interrupted.

confirmRemove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
confirmRemove.description: Tether stops managing this session. Its transcripts on disk are not deleted.
confirmRemove.killHint: Ends tmux session “{{tmux}}” and the Claude Code process inside it.

general.languageHint: For the dashboard, and the default for the Telegram bot.
general.defaultPermissionHint: Preselected when you create or adopt a session.
general.idleLockHint: The Telegram bot asks for the password again after this long without use.

telegram.enabledHint: Turn the bot on or off without removing its token.
telegram.tokenHint: Create a bot and get its token from
telegram.tokenSet: Token set (…{{hint}}). Paste a new one to replace it.
telegram.usersHint: Telegram accounts that shared an allowed phone number and entered the password.
telegram.noUsersHint: Open your bot in Telegram and send /start to verify yourself.
telegram.revokeDescription: {{phone}} will need to verify again (contact and password) to use the bot.

security.model: The Telegram bot always requires two things: the dashboard password and a Telegram account whose verified number is on the allowed list. That is why at least one number must stay on the list.
security.phonesHint: Telegram accounts must share one of these numbers as their contact to use the bot.
security.label: Label
security.lastPhone: The last number can't be removed: the bot needs at least one allowed number. Add another first.
